Of all the tickets printed for "EMERALD MINE 9X", only a small slice are still unsold. The game is near the end of its run, with one of ten top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

The numbers for "EMERALD MINE 9X" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
5055.headline: How far along this game is

5057.body:
"EASY MONEY" has three of eight top prizes left and is past the halfway point of its run. About three-quarters of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, a larger share of the top prizes is left than of the tickets, which is a good sign.

Everything above about "EASY MONEY" comes from the Florida Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
5057.headline: Early stage or late

5059.body:
The top prize count on "THE CASH WHEEL" has not moved since we started watching it. The game still has two of six top prizes unclaimed. Smaller prizes keep getting claimed as tickets sell. The same top prizes are now among fewer tickets.

If you play "THE CASH WHEEL" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
5059.headline: Top prizes have lasted so far

5060.body:
"FIND THE 7S" paid out its last $50,000 prize six months ago. The ticket still advertises it because printed tickets never change. Prize tables do change, and the biggest prize listed today is $10,000.

Every line of FIND THE 7S's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
5060.headline: Big prize shown, none left

5063.body:
On "CA$H IN HAND", one $2 million top prize was claimed over a week ago. That leaves two of the original four. The prize table has today's count for every prize level.

If you play "CA$H IN HAND" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
